policy: Reviewed, hand-authored independent cores. Pipes separate a source ID suffix from its approved replacement, never a runtime word-stripping rule. Exact duplicates share one canonical value; additional semantic consolidations below are explicit. A split preserves its full original only in the historical archive. It never automatically inserts extracted categories.
editorialNotes: Sign seeker is ambiguous; resolve it as seeking answers and consolidate with the existing Questioner role, without selecting directions, omens or physical signs.
Inventor becomes Creator and Puppeteer becomes Manipulator in Role; their literal occupations are separately selectable Profession values.
A service provider/customer is an inherent connection, not a selected job or workplace. The regular-customer variants consolidate to that connection rather than inventing a profession.

First-meeting, equal-standing and mandatory-movement premises have no atomic clearance. Their aliases express expectation, disputed authority or a fictional obstacle; their exact former instructions remain historical.

Performance constraints such as seated-only, hands-only, remembered-route and noise rules are not new generation controls. Their neutral fictional aliases retain the underlying pressure without instructing performance.

Actions can keep generic activities such as preparing a meal, wrapping a present or organizing a feast. A particular prop is never silently added. takes_object is limited to reviewed direct-transitive gerunds.
The original advice problems remain exact historical game inputs. Their same-category aliases are scene circumstances, not rewritten advice questions.

All neutralized cores default to Clean; retained attraction wording is explicitly Spicy. New adult circumstances are non-graphic misunderstandings about intimacy without assigning a partner, prop, place, job or required response.

Relationship cast partitions are deliberate: two, three, and four-to-twelve never merge across ranges. Group, crew, team, club, committee and board connections remain distinct, but their industry variants consolidate.
Genre conventions, nuanced emotions, physical object attributes and specialist professions remain specific within their own category.

Five new Mature professions name genuine adult-specialist jobs only; three new Mature opening lines are the selected dialogue inputs themselves, not hints. They add meaningful adult tone without assigning props, relationships, places, scripted actions or artificial quotas. Film-set intimacy coordinator clarifies the existing specialist job without changing its rating or task eligibility.
